title_en: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol With a 20% Cheaper Astra API
title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，Astra API 价格降低 20%
summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, two closed models for professional and agentic work. Astra is the frontier tier for long-horizon tasks, while Sol is the efficient everyday tier. Both support a 1,050,000-token context window and are available via API as gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol. Astra scores 62 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (second to Claude Fable 5.2's 65) and ranks #1 on AA-3D with 1,318 Elo. Astra's API prices are 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra at $8/$40 per 1M input/output tokens, with cached input at $0.40.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布了 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 两款闭源模型，分别面向专业长周期任务和高效日常任务。两者均支持 1,050,000 token 上下文窗口，并通过 API 以 gpt-6.2-astra 和 gpt-6.2-sol 提供。Astra 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得 62 分，仅次于 Claude Fable 5.2 的 65 分，并在 AA-3D 上以 1,318 Elo 排名第一。Astra 的 API 价格较 GPT-6 Astra 降低 20%，输入/输出分别为每百万 token 8 美元和 40 美元，缓存输入为 0.40 美元。
content_en:
OpenAI has released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, twp closed models aimed at professional and agentic work. The GPT-6.2 Astra model is the new frontier tier for hard, long-horizon tasks. GPT-6.2 Sol is the efficient everyday tier. For developers, the key point is cost per task. Astra’s token prices fall 20%, and OpenAI says both models finish tasks with fewer output tokens. Both are live in the OpenAI API as `gpt-6.2-astra` and `gpt-6.2-sol`.

## **TL;DR**

- **Size:** 1,050,000-token context window, 922,000 max input, 128,000 max output.
- **Runs on:** OpenAI’s hosted API, ChatGPT Work and Codex only.
- **Performance:** Astra scores 62 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, second behind Claude Fable 5.2 (65).
- **Best:** Astra ranks #1 on AA-3D with 1,318 Elo, ahead of Fable 5.2 (1,271).
- **Worst:** Astra posts a 59% AA-Omniscience hallucination rate (Sol: 55%). Sol’s Coding Agent Index drops 3 points.
- **Bottom line:** Best: frontier results at much lower cost per task. Worst: no coding gains, and hallucination stays high.

## **What is GPT-6.2 Astra?**

GPT-6.2 Astra is OpenAI’s frontier reasoning model for complex professional work. It succeeds GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI says it produces cleaner slides, spreadsheets and documents that follow templates and field conventions. It also builds better frontends, games and 3D scenes.

GPT-6.2 Sol replaces GPT-6.1 Sol as the everyday model.

## **How do the two models differ?**

Both accept text and image input and return text. Both share the same context limits. The split is cost and depth.

- **Astra:** knowledge cutoff May 18, 2026. Built for the hardest multistep work.
- **Sol:** knowledge cutoff June 1, 2026. Built for fast, versatile everyday tasks.

Neither model accepts reasoning effort `none`. OpenAI recommends keeping prompt prefixes unchanged and appending new instructions. That improves cache reuse and preserves reasoning across turns.

## **What do the benchmarks show?**

**OpenAI’s own claims focus on cost-adjusted gains:**

- **Agents’ Last Exam v1.1:** Astra scores 5.2 points above GPT-6 Astra at under a third of the cost. It leads Claude Fable 5.2 by 5.5 points at 5% of the cost.
- **Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1:** Astra gains 9 points over GPT-6 Astra at under a third of the cost.
- **GDPval v2 (internal):** Astra gains 6.2 points with 22% fewer output tokens. Sol gains 5.3 points over GPT-6.1 Sol.
- **FrontierCode 2.0:** Sol lands within 0.5 points of Astra at about one-fifth the cost.
- **AA-AnalystAgent:** Astra answers 62.5% of questions correctly on all 5 attempts.

Independent results from Artificial Analysis mostly hold up. Astra scores 62 at max effort, with a $4.00 cost per Intelligence Index task. Fable 5.2 scores 65, Gemini 4 Carbon 60, Claude Opus 5.5 59 and Sol 57. Sol matches GPT-6 Astra’s score at about 15% of its cost per task.

On Harvey LAB-AA, Astra passes 15.0% of legal assignments. The Astra for Law configuration passes 20.8%. Epoch’s Capabilities Index puts Astra at 174, tied with Fable 5.2.

## **How much does GPT-6.2 cost in the API?**

| Rate (per 1M tokens) | GPT-6.2 Astra | GPT-6.2 Sol | 
|---|---|---|
| Input | $8.00 | $2.00 | 
| Cached input | $0.40 | $0.10 | 
| Output | $40.00 | $10.00 | 

Astra’s input and output prices are 20% below GPT-6 Astra. Cached input is 60% cheaper. Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol’s rates. Requests over 272K input tokens double input and cache rates, and output costs 1.5x. Batch is 50% of standard. Ultrafast is 3x standard through February 28, 2027, then 6x.

## **How does it compare with competitors?**

| Feature | GPT-6.2 Astra | GPT-6.2 Sol | Claude Fable 5.2 | Gemini 4 Carbon | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Parameters | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 
| Context window | 1,050,000 | 1,050,000 | 1,000,000 | 1,048,576 | 
| Max output | 128,000 | 128,000 | 128,000 | Not disclosed | 
| Input / output price | $8 / $40 | $2 / $10 | $8 / $40 | $2 / $10 (until Nov 30), then $4 / $20 | 
| Cached input | $0.40 | $0.10 | $0.20 | $0.10 (intro) | 
| AA Intelligence Index | 62 | 57 | 65 | 60 | 
| AA-3D Elo | 1,318 | 1,259 | 1,271 | Not disclosed | 
| AA-Robotics v0.1 | 79 | 78 | 75 | Not disclosed | 
| Weights | Closed | Closed | Closed | Closed | 

Index, AA-3D and robotics figures for competitors come from Artificial Analysis as reported by The Decoder.

Astra is also OpenAI’s first released model to meet the High threshold for AI self-improvement.

## **Key Takeaways**

- Astra drops to $8/$40 per 1M tokens, 20% below GPT-6 Astra.
- Astra ranks #2 on the AA Intelligence Index with 62 points.
- Sol nearly matches Astra on FrontierCode 2.0 at one-fifth the cost.
- Coding agent scores did not improve, and Sol slipped 3 points.
- Both models ship with a 1.05M-token context and 128K max output.

content_zh:
OpenAI 已发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol，这两款闭源模型面向专业工作和智能体工作。GPT-6.2 Astra 模型是面向高难度、长周期任务的新前沿层级。GPT-6.2 Sol 是高效的日常层级。对开发者而言，关键点是每任务成本。Astra 的 token 价格下降 20%，OpenAI 表示两款模型完成任务的输出 token 更少。两者均已在 OpenAI API 中上线，模型名分别为 `gpt-6.2-astra` 和 `gpt-6.2-sol`。

## **要点速览**

- **规模：** 1,050,000 token 上下文窗口，最大输入 922,000，最大输出 128,000。
- **运行于：** 仅 OpenAI 托管 API、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex。
- **性能：** Astra 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上得分 62，仅次于 Claude Fable 5.2（65）。
- **最佳：** Astra 以 1,318 Elo 在 AA-3D 上排名第 1，领先 Fable 5.2（1,271）。
- **最差：** Astra 的 AA-Omniscience 幻觉率为 59%（Sol：55%）。Sol 的 Coding Agent Index 下降 3 分。
- **结论：** 最佳：以低得多的每任务成本取得前沿结果。最差：编码能力没有提升，幻觉率仍然偏高。

## **GPT-6.2 Astra 是什么？**

GPT-6.2 Astra 是 OpenAI 面向复杂专业工作的前沿推理模型。它接替 GPT-6 Astra。OpenAI 表示，它能生成更整洁的幻灯片、电子表格和文档，并遵循模板和字段约定。它还能构建更好的前端、游戏和 3D 场景。

GPT-6.2 Sol 接替 GPT-6.1 Sol，成为日常模型。

## **两款模型有何不同？**

两者均接受文本和图像输入并返回文本。两者共享相同的上下文限制。区别在于成本和深度。

- **Astra：** 知识截止日期为 2026 年 5 月 18 日。专为最困难的多步骤工作打造。
- **Sol：** 知识截止日期为 2026 年 6 月 1 日。专为快速、多用途的日常任务打造。

两款模型均不接受推理强度 `none`。OpenAI 建议保持提示前缀不变，并追加新指令。这有助于提高缓存复用率，并在多轮对话中保留推理。

## **基准测试显示了什么？**

**OpenAI 自身的说法侧重于成本调整后的收益：**

- **Agents’ Last Exam v1.1：** Astra 的得分比 GPT-6 Astra 高 5.2 分，成本不到后者的三分之一。它以 5% 的成本领先 Claude Fable 5.2 5.5 分。
- **Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1：** Astra 比 GPT-6 Astra 提升 9 分，成本不到后者的三分之一。
- **GDPval v2（内部）：** Astra 提升 6.2 分，输出 token 减少 22%。Sol 比 GPT-6.1 Sol 提升 5.3 分。
- **FrontierCode 2.0：** Sol 与 Astra 的差距在 0.5 分以内，成本约为后者的五分之一。
- **AA-AnalystAgent：** Astra 在全部 5 次尝试中正确回答了 62.5% 的问题。

Artificial Analysis 的独立结果基本吻合。Astra 在最大推理强度下得分 62，每个 Intelligence Index 任务成本为 $4.00。Fable 5.2 得分 65，Gemini 4 Carbon 60，Claude Opus 5.5 59，Sol 57。Sol 以约 15% 的每任务成本达到 GPT-6 Astra 的得分。

在 Harvey LAB-AA 上，Astra 通过了 15.0% 的法律任务。Astra for Law 配置通过了 20.8%。Epoch 的 Capabilities Index 将 Astra 列为 174，与 Fable 5.2 并列。

## **GPT-6.2 在 API 中价格如何？**

| 价格（每 100 万 tokens） | GPT-6.2 Astra | GPT-6.2 Sol |
|---|---|---|
| 输入 | $8.00 | $2.00 |
| 缓存输入 | $0.40 | $0.10 |
| 输出 | $40.00 | $10.00 |

Astra 的输入和输出价格比 GPT-6 Astra 低 20%。缓存输入便宜 60%。Sol 保持 GPT-6.1 Sol 的价格。输入超过 272K tokens 的请求，输入和缓存费率翻倍，输出费用为 1.5 倍。Batch 为标准价格的 50%。Ultrafast 在 2027 年 2 月 28 日之前为标准价格的 3 倍，之后为 6 倍。

## **与竞争对手相比如何？**

| 特性 | GPT-6.2 Astra | GPT-6.2 Sol | Claude Fable 5.2 | Gemini 4 Carbon |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 参数 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 |
| 上下文窗口 | 1,050,000 | 1,050,000 | 1,000,000 | 1,048,576 |
| 最大输出 | 128,000 | 128,000 | 128,000 | 未披露 |
| 输入 / 输出价格 | $8 / $40 | $2 / $10 | $8 / $40 | $2 / $10（截至 11 月 30 日），之后 $4 / $20 |
| 缓存输入 | $0.40 | $0.10 | $0.20 | $0.10（intro） |
| AA Intelligence Index | 62 | 57 | 65 | 60 |
| AA-3D Elo | 1,318 | 1,259 | 1,271 | 未披露 |
| AA-Robotics v0.1 | 79 | 78 | 75 | 未披露 |
| 权重 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 闭源 |

竞争对手的 Index、AA-3D 和机器人数据来自 The Decoder 报道的 Artificial Analysis。

Astra 也是 OpenAI 首个达到 AI 自我改进 High 阈值的已发布模型。

## **要点速览**

- Astra 降至每 100 万 tokens $8/$40，比 GPT-6 Astra 低 20%。
- Astra 以 62 分在 AA Intelligence Index 上排名第 2。
- Sol 在 FrontierCode 2.0 上几乎与 Astra 持平，成本仅为五分之一。
- 编码 agent 分数没有提升，Sol 下降了 3 分。
- 两个模型均配备 1.05M tokens 上下文和 128K 最大输出。
